diglot.guessPrompt: What does this word mean? Make a guess first, then read the definition.
diglot.settingsHint: Some words in the chat are replaced with the language being learned
diglot.llmRefineHint: The AI picks the word that fits the sentence. Accuracy is higher, and each message costs a small amount.
diglot.learningWordsEmpty: Once a chat starts, the words picked up appear here.
diglot.pairDownloadFailed: The download did not finish. It can be selected again. The current language is unchanged.
diglot.noPackForLanguage: The AI currently answers in {{language}}, and there is no word data for that language. Word data exists for: {{languages}}. Changing the language the AI answers in to one of those allows learning to start.
diglot.placementHint: Thirty words, about two minutes. Afterwards new words start from the level already reached, rather than from the very beginning. It can be skipped.
diglot.installedHint: It can be downloaded again after removal, and the words already learned are kept.
diglot.removedCurrentPack: That language's word data has been removed. The current pair is back to learning {{target}} from {{source}}.

door.guessPrompt: Make a guess first: what is it, in one sentence?

focus.mapHint: Select a stop to jump there. Solid lines grew from a word picked in the text; dashed lines grew from a question.
focus.errorPlain: This stop was not generated. You can try again, or leave focus.
focus.errorWithReason: This stop was not generated: {{reason}}. You can try again, or leave focus.
focus.errorNoApi: This stop was not generated: no AI service is configured yet. Entering one in settings allows another attempt.

teach.opener: I am learning "{{topic}}" and have not really understood it yet. Could you explain it in your own words? Starting from what it is would be enough.
